validationChecklist: Parse trail.research.json, research-progress.json, all sections/*.research.json, geometry/geometry-index.research.json and both new normalization handoff JSON files.
Confirm expected section count is 35 and every section has canonical and draw-ready geometry.
Validate every canonical/draw-ready GeoJSON Feature geometry type and coordinate order.
Confirm draw-ready geometry is not used as canonical provenance.
Confirm N5, K3 and K4 official breaks are preserved and not bridged by generated geometry.
Confirm K4-to-K5 is represented as a known official network gap.
Run endpoint gap report and review all snaps above the chosen threshold.
Compare official distances, computed distances and section source contradictions before exposing distances.
Run facility cluster/dedupe pass and verify pending/OSM-only/private/seasonal records before import.
Run final GIS overlays for protected areas, water-protection zones and restriction subsegments.
Run live fire, transit, closure/reroute, seasonal service and beach/reserve rule checks immediately before publication.
Confirm no runtime app data, generated public data, shared scripts or package files are modified by the normalization-prep pass.
